reports.title: School Rooms
reports.summary: The eight schools' exam rooms on a phone and two tablets, with desk counts by rating and how room size sets pace and difficulty.

reports.title: Student Characters
reports.summary: The exam students' bodies, hair, clothes and left-handers, every animation clip, the whispering pair in a real exam, and the known limits.

reports.title: Classroom Door
reports.summary: A student removed during the exam walks the aisle and leaves through the classroom door, which opens and closes behind them, from every seat.

reports.title: Admission Photo Check
reports.summary: The photo check at the door: the document photo beside a live camera still, every case on a phone screen, and the waiting queue.

reports.title: Whisper Sound
reports.summary: The whisper in the game: real recordings made wordless, in male and female voices matched to the student, with audio and measurements.

reports.title: Exam Bell Sounds
reports.summary: Fifteen bells synthesized in code for the end of exam time, each playable with its parameters, including the electric bell now in the game.

reports.title: Baked Game Art
reports.summary: The game's Blender-rendered art: a building per school, the exam room on the title and brief, event objects and icons, in both themes.

reports.title: Game Feel
reports.summary: The reward motion: coins flying to the balance on payday, a result card that counts up, a lit promotion and a toast for each action.

reports.title: Schools and Offers
reports.summary: Eight schools with fixed star ratings, how job offers compare rating and salary, and how school rating follows standing across whole careers.

reports.title: Phone Check
reports.summary: The game on a real Galaxy A15: every school hub and room, offers, event art and frame rates, with the issues it found now fixed.
